situation: There's a guy in my Tuesday pottery class, we always end up talking about podcasts. The course ends next week and I want to ask him out without it being weird.
reply: I'm going to miss our Tuesday podcast debates when this course ends. Would you want to grab a drink after the last class next week, just the two of us? Totally fine if not, I'll still send you that Serial episode.
note: The deadline of the last class gives a natural reason to ask now; the out is light and real.

situation: Ayer tuve la primera cita con Lucía, la conocí en Hinge. Fuimos a un bar de vermut en Lavapiés y estuvimos tres horas hablando. Quiero escribirle hoy sin parecer intenso.
reply: Me lo pasé genial ayer. Sigo pensando en tu teoría de que las croquetas de jamón están sobrevaloradas, y sigo sin estar de acuerdo. ¿Repetimos? El sábado hay un mercadillo en Matadero que creo que te gustaría.

situation: 相亲认识的女生，吃过一次火锅，聊得挺好。之后我发的两条她都回得很短，最后一条三天没回了。想再发最后一条。
reply: 不用有压力，就是想说上次那顿火锅吃得很开心。如果你哪天想再出来喝杯咖啡，我都在。
note: 对方变冷淡时只发一条轻松的消息，不追问为什么没回，然后就放下。

situation: Been messaging a guy named Theo on Bumble for about a week, great back and forth about hiking and bad horror movies. I want to suggest meeting in person but don't want it to feel like pressure.
reply: I'm enjoying this and I'd rather keep it going in person. A drink this week? I'm free Thursday evening or Sunday afternoon, and there's a bar on Elm Street that screens terrible horror movies on Sundays, which feels like a sign. No pressure if you'd rather keep chatting here a bit longer.
note: Moving off the app: two specific slots, one hook from your own chat, and an easy out so a yes costs nothing.

situation: Met a woman called Ines at my friend Kofi's birthday on Saturday, we talked about bouldering for like an hour. Kofi gave me her Instagram. I want to DM her and ask her out without being creepy.
reply: Hi Ines, it's Daniel from Kofi's birthday on Saturday, the one who got a full lecture on why bouldering beats the gym. This is a bit forward, but I'd regret not asking: would you want to get a drink with me this week? Thursday evening or Sunday afternoon both work. No pressure at all if not.
note: Someone you've met once: remind her who you are with a detail from the night, one clear plan, and an out she can take in a word.

situation: Asked Jordan (we met at a friend's housewarming) if she wanted to get a drink Thursday. She said 'this week's crazy, maybe another time?' Not sure if that's a no. How do I reply without pushing?
reply: No worries at all, sounds like a big week. I'd still love to get that drink, so if things calm down, tell me a night that works and I'll pick the place.
note: After a soft maybe, hand the next move to them once. If no night comes back, that is the answer; don't ask again.

situation: 上周六和在朋友婚礼上认识的女生小林第一次约会，一起看了个展，又吃了顿饭，聊了四个小时。第二天她还把展上拍的照片发给了我。想约第二次，国庆假期我都在北京。
reply: 你拍的那张装置照片我存了，比我拍的好看多了。想再见你一次：10月3日周六晚上798有个夜间市集，要不要一起去逛逛？如果想轻松点，找个下午喝杯咖啡也行，看你。
note: 约第二次也是具体计划加一个更轻的选项；开头接住她发来的照片，而不是问“还想见面吗”。
